[[File:Doug and Eva.png|thumb|250px|Eva and Doug (center) in {{aniseries|JN}}]] '''Doug''' (Japanese: '''ダグ''' ''Doug'') and '''Eva''' (Japanese: '''エバ''' ''Eva'') are a father and daughter who live in an unnamed town in southern [[Galar]]. They are [[character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|JN}} episode ''[[JN042|Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!]]''. ==In animation== ===History=== Eva was feeding her father's {{p|Centiskorch}}, [[nickname]]d Centy, some [[Oran Berry|Oran Berries]], when it was suddenly hit by a beam of [[Dynamax]] energy that came all the way from the [[Energy Plant]] in [[Hammerlocke]]. This caused Centy to [[Gigantamax]] and go on a rampage throughout the town. Shortly afterwards, {{Ash}} arrived at the town and met up with Doug and Eva. After talking to them, Ash promised to stop Centy and return it to normal. After failing to do so, {{an|Leon}} stepped in and defeated Centy with his {{TP|Leon|Charizard}}. The Radiator Pokémon subsequently returned to normal and reunited with Doug and Eva. ===Pokémon=== ====Doug==== This listing is of Doug's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Doug |nick=Centy |giga=yes |pkmn=Centiskorch |type1=Fire |type2=Bug |img=Doug Centy.png |img2=Doug Gigantamax Centy.png |cap2=Doug's Gigantamax Centiskorch |epnum=JN042 |epname=Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald! |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Ray Chase |desc={{p|Centiskorch|Centy}} (Japanese: '''マルちゃん''' ''Maru-chan'') is Doug's only known Pokémon. It is a friendly Pokémon that lives with Doug and his daughter Eva. When Eva was feeding it some [[Oran Berry|Oran Berries]], it was suddenly hit by a beam of [[Dynamax]] energy that came all the way from the [[Energy Plant]] in [[Hammerlocke]]. This caused Centy to [[Gigantamax]] and rampage throughout the town. Centy was ultimately defeated by [[Leon's Charizard]], causing the Radiator Pokémon to return to normal and reunite with Doug and Eva. None of Centy's moves are known{{tt|*|Centy is implied to know a Fire-type and Bug-type attack due to the use of G-Max Centiferno and Max Flutterby respectively}}.
